gloss: business partner; affiliated company; tie-up partner

definitions.gloss: business partner; affiliated company; tie-up partner; partner organization
definitions.explanation: A company, organization, or store with which one has a formal business alliance or tie-up — the "other side" of a business partnership. Common in corporate, financial, and travel-industry contexts.

examples.japanese: {提携先|ていけいさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{提携先|ていけいさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: You can use this card at affiliated stores as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{提携先|ていけいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧、{販路|はんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げたい→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: We want to find new business partners and expand our sales channels.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{提携先|ていけいさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}する→出張する：26986_shucchousuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I will go on a business trip to Europe next week for a meeting with our overseas partner.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{提携|ていけい}→提携：05773_teikei⟧ (tie-up, alliance, cooperation) and the suffix ～⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (the other party; the destination or counterpart of an action). The suffix ～⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ productively turns verbs and verbal nouns into nouns meaning "the party/place on the receiving or counterpart side": ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧ (business client), ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact information / person to contact), ⟦{勤務先|きんむさき}→勤務先：08368_kinmusaki⟧ (place of employment).

USAGE:
Common in business, finance, retail, and travel contexts. Frequently seen in press releases, company profiles, and points/credit-card program descriptions ("affiliated stores").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {提携先|ていけいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a partner
- {提携先|ていけいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a partner
- {提携先|ていけいさき}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: partner company
- {提携先|ていけいさき}⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧: affiliated store

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧: business client/customer — emphasizes ongoing transactional relationships rather than formal alliance
- {協力先|きょうりょくさき}: cooperating party — emphasizes cooperation on a specific project rather than a standing partnership
- ⟦{関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}→関連会社：19758_kanrengaisha⟧: affiliated company — a legal/corporate term for companies connected by ownership
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}{提携|ていけい}→業務提携：22907_gyoumuteikei⟧: business tie-up — the relationship itself, not the counterpart
